MODE.description: This bits decides which one operation mode will be used. 3'd0: AES-EN-128, 3'd1: AES-EN-192, 3'd2: AES-EN-256, 3'd4: AES-DE-128, 3'd5: AES-DE-192, 3'd6: AES-DE-256.

ENDIAN.description: endian. [1:0] key endian, [3:2] text_in endian or in_stream endian,  [5:4] text_out endian or out_stream endian

TRIGGER.description: Set this bit to start AES calculation.

STATE.description: Those bits shows AES status. For typical AES, 0: idle, 1: busy. For DMA-AES, 0: idle, 1: busy, 2: calculation_done.

IV_MEM[0].description: The memory that stores initialization vector

IV_MEM[1].description: The memory that stores initialization vector

IV_MEM[2].description: The memory that stores initialization vector

IV_MEM[3].description: The memory that stores initialization vector

H_MEM[0].description: The memory that stores GCM hash subkey

H_MEM[1].description: The memory that stores GCM hash subkey

H_MEM[2].description: The memory that stores GCM hash subkey

H_MEM[3].description: The memory that stores GCM hash subkey

DMA_ENABLE.description: 1'b0: typical AES working mode, 1'b1: DMA-AES working mode.

BLOCK_MODE.description: Those bits decides which block mode will be used. 0x0: ECB, 0x1: CBC, 0x2: OFB, 0x3: CTR, 0x4: CFB-8, 0x5: CFB-128, 0x6: GCM, 0x7: reserved.

BLOCK_NUM.description: Those bits stores the number of Plaintext/ciphertext block.

INC_SEL.description: This bit decides the standard incrementing function. 0: INC32. 1: INC128.

AAD_BLOCK_NUM.description: Additional Authential Data block number register
Those bits stores the number of AAD block.

REMAINDER_BIT_NUM.description: Those bits stores the number of remainder bit.

CONTINUE.description: Set this bit to continue GCM operation.

INT_CLEAR.description: Set this bit to clear the AES interrupt.

INT_ENA.description: AES Interrupt enable register
Set this bit to enable interrupt that occurs when DMA-AES calculation is done.

DATE.description: This bits stores the version information of AES.

DMA_EXIT.description: Set this register to leave calculation done stage. Recommend to use it after software finishes reading DMA's output buffer.

IN_DONE_CH_INT_RAW.description: The raw interrupt bit turns to high level when the last data pointed by one inlink descriptor has been received for Rx channel 0.

LOCK_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable lock operation. It will be cleared by hardware after lock operation done. Note that (1) this bit and unlock_ena bit are mutually exclusive, that is, those bits can not be set to 1 at the same time. (2) lock operation can be applied on LL1-ICache, L1-DCache and L2-Cache.

UNLOCK_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable unlock operation. It will be cleared by hardware after unlock operation done. Note that (1) this bit and lock_ena bit are mutually exclusive, that is, those bits can not be set to 1 at the same time. (2) unlock operation can be applied on L1-ICache, L1-DCache and L2-Cache.

LOCK_DONE.description: The bit is used to indicate whether unlock/lock operation is finished or not. 0: not finished. 1: finished.

LOCK_RGID.description: The bit is used to set  the gid of cache lock/unlock.

LOCK_MAP.description: Those bits are used to indicate which caches in the two-level cache structure will apply this lock/unlock operation. [0]: L1-ICache0, [1]: L1-ICache1, [2]: L1-ICache2, [3]: L1-ICache3, [4]: L1-DCache, [5]: L2-Cache.

LOCK_ADDR.description: Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of the lock/unlock operation, which should be used together with CACHE_LOCK_SIZE_REG

LOCK_SIZE.description: Those bits are used to configure the size of the lock/unlock operation, which should be used together with CACHE_LOCK_ADDR_REG

INVALIDATE_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable invalidate operation. It will be cleared by hardware after invalidate operation done. Note that this bit and the other sync-bits (clean_ena, writeback_ena, writeback_invalidate_ena) are mutually exclusive, that is, those bits can not be set to 1 at the same time.

CLEAN_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable clean operation. It will be cleared by hardware after clean operation done. Note that this bit and the other sync-bits (invalidate_ena, writeback_ena, writeback_invalidate_ena) are mutually exclusive, that is, those bits can not be set to 1 at the same time.

WRITEBACK_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable writeback operation. It will be cleared by hardware after writeback operation done. Note that this bit and the other sync-bits (invalidate_ena, clean_ena, writeback_invalidate_ena) are mutually exclusive, that is, those bits can not be set to 1 at the same time.

WRITEBACK_INVALIDATE_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable writeback-invalidate operation. It will be cleared by hardware after writeback-invalidate operation done. Note that this bit and the other sync-bits (invalidate_ena, clean_ena, writeback_ena) are mutually exclusive, that is, those bits can not be set to 1 at the same time.

SYNC_DONE.description: The bit is used to indicate whether sync operation (invalidate, clean, writeback, writeback_invalidate) is finished or not. 0: not finished. 1: finished.

SYNC_RGID.description: The bit is used to set  the gid of cache sync operation (invalidate, clean, writeback, writeback_invalidate)

SYNC_MAP.description: Those bits are used to indicate which caches in the two-level cache structure will apply the sync operation. [0]: L1-ICache0, [1]: L1-ICache1, [2]: L1-ICache2, [3]: L1-ICache3, [4]: L1-DCache, [5]: L2-Cache.

SYNC_ADDR.description: Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of the sync operation, which should be used together with CACHE_SYNC_SIZE_REG

SYNC_SIZE.description: Those bits are used to configure the size of the sync operation, which should be used together with CACHE_SYNC_ADDR_REG

L2_CACHE_WRAP.description: Set this bit as 1 to enable L2-Cache wrap around mode.

L2_CACHE_TAG_MEM_POWER_CTRL.description: Cache tag memory power control register

L2_CACHE_TAG_MEM_FORCE_ON.description: The bit is used to close clock gating of  L2-Cache tag memory. 1: close gating, 0: open clock gating.

L2_CACHE_TAG_MEM_FORCE_PD.description: The bit is used to power L2-Cache tag memory down. 0: follow rtc_lslp, 1: power down

L2_CACHE_TAG_MEM_FORCE_PU.description: The bit is used to power L2-Cache tag memory up. 0: follow rtc_lslp, 1: power up

L2_CACHE_DATA_MEM_POWER_CTRL.description: Cache data memory power control register

L2_CACHE_DATA_MEM_FORCE_ON.description: The bit is used to close clock gating of  L2-Cache data memory. 1: close gating, 0: open clock gating.

L2_CACHE_DATA_MEM_FORCE_PD.description: The bit is used to power L2-Cache data memory down. 0: follow rtc_lslp, 1: power down

L2_CACHE_DATA_MEM_FORCE_PU.description: The bit is used to power L2-Cache data memory up. 0: follow rtc_lslp, 1: power up

L2_CACHE_FREEZE_EN.description: The bit is used to enable freeze operation on L2-Cache. It can be cleared by software.

L2_CACHE_FREEZE_MODE.description: The bit is used to configure mode of freeze operation L2-Cache. 0: a miss-access will not stuck. 1: a miss-access will stuck.

L2_CACHE_FREEZE_DONE.description: The bit is used to indicate whether freeze operation on L2-Cache is finished or not. 0: not finished. 1: finished.

L2_CACHE_DATA_MEM_ACS_CONF.description: Cache data memory access configure register

L2_CACHE_DATA_MEM_RD_EN.description: The bit is used to enable config-bus read L2-Cache data memoryory. 0: disable, 1: enable.

L2_CACHE_DATA_MEM_WR_EN.description: The bit is used to enable config-bus write L2-Cache data memoryory. 0: disable, 1: enable.

L2_CACHE_TAG_MEM_ACS_CONF.description: Cache tag memory access configure register

L2_CACHE_TAG_MEM_RD_EN.description: The bit is used to enable config-bus read L2-Cache tag memoryory. 0: disable, 1: enable.

L2_CACHE_TAG_MEM_WR_EN.description: The bit is used to enable config-bus write L2-Cache tag memoryory. 0: disable, 1: enable.

L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_EN.description: The bit is used to enable the first section of prelock function on L2-Cache.

L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_EN.description: The bit is used to enable the second section of prelock function on L2-Cache.

L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_RGID.description: The bit is used to set  the gid of l2 cache prelock.

L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_ADDR.description: L2 Cache prelock section0 address configure register
Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of the first section of prelock on L2-Cache, which should be used together with L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_SIZE_REG

L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_ADDR.description: L2 Cache prelock section1 address configure register
Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of the second section of prelock on L2-Cache, which should be used together with L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_SIZE_REG

L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT_SIZE.description: L2 Cache prelock section size configure register

L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_SIZE.description: Those bits are used to configure the size of the first section of prelock on L2-Cache, which should be used together with L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT0_ADDR_REG

L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_SIZE.description: Those bits are used to configure the size of the second section of prelock on L2-Cache, which should be used together with L2_CACHE_PRELOCK_SCT1_ADDR_REG

L2_CACHE_PRELOAD_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable preload operation on L2-Cache. It will be cleared by hardware automatically after preload operation is done.

L2_CACHE_PRELOAD_DONE.description: The bit is used to indicate whether preload operation is finished or not. 0: not finished. 1: finished.

L2_CACHE_PRELOAD_ORDER.description: The bit is used to configure the direction of preload operation. 0: ascending, 1: descending.

L2_CACHE_PRELOAD_RGID.description: The bit is used to set  the gid of l2 cache preload.

L2_CACHE_PRELOAD_ADDR.description: L2 Cache preload address configure register
Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of preload on L2-Cache, which should be used together with L2_CACHE_PRELOAD_SIZE_REG

L2_CACHE_PRELOAD_SIZE.description: L2 Cache preload size configure register
Those bits are used to configure the size of the first section of prelock on L2-Cache, which should be used together with L2_CACHE_PRELOAD_ADDR_REG

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable and disable autoload operation on L2-Cache.  1: enable, 0: disable.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_DONE.description: The bit is used to indicate whether autoload operation on L2-Cache is finished or not. 0: not finished. 1: finished.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_ORDER.description: The bit is used to configure the direction of autoload operation on L2-Cache. 0: ascending. 1: descending.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_TRIGGER_MODE.description: The field is used to configure trigger mode of autoload operation on L2-Cache. 0/3: miss-trigger, 1: hit-trigger, 2: miss-hit-trigger.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT0_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable the first section for autoload operation on L2-Cache.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT1_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable the second section for autoload operation on L2-Cache.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT2_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable the third section for autoload operation on L2-Cache.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT3_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable the fourth section for autoload operation on L2-Cache.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_RGID.description: The bit is used to set  the gid of l2 cache autoload.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT0_ADDR.description: L2 Cache autoload section 0 address configure register

Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of the first section for autoload operation on L2-Cache. Note that it should be used together with L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT0_SIZE and L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT0_ENA.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT0_SIZE.description: L2 Cache autoload section 0 size configure register

Those bits are used to configure the size of the first section for autoload operation on L2-Cache. Note that it should be used together with L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT0_ADDR and L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT0_ENA.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT1_ADDR.description: L2 Cache autoload section 1 address configure register

Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of the second section for autoload operation on L2-Cache. Note that it should be used together with L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT1_SIZE and L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT1_ENA.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT1_SIZE.description: L2 Cache autoload section 1 size configure register

Those bits are used to configure the size of the second section for autoload operation on L2-Cache. Note that it should be used together with L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT1_ADDR and L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT1_ENA.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT2_ADDR.description: L2 Cache autoload section 2 address configure register

Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of the third section for autoload operation on L2-Cache. Note that it should be used together with L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT2_SIZE and L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT2_ENA.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT2_SIZE.description: L2 Cache autoload section 2 size configure register

Those bits are used to configure the size of the third section for autoload operation on L2-Cache. Note that it should be used together with L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT2_ADDR and L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT2_ENA.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT3_ADDR.description: L2 Cache autoload section 3 address configure register

Those bits are used to configure the start virtual address of the fourth section for autoload operation on L2-Cache. Note that it should be used together with L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT3_SIZE and L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT3_ENA.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT3_SIZE.description: L2 Cache autoload section 3 size configure register

Those bits are used to configure the size of the fourth section for autoload operation on L2-Cache. Note that it should be used together with L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT3_ADDR and L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_SCT3_ENA.

L2_CACHE_PLD_ERR_INT_ENA.description: The bit is used to enable interrupt of L2-Cache preload-operation error.

L2_CACHE_SYNC_PRELOAD_INT_CLR.description: Sync Preload operation Interrupt clear register

L2_CACHE_PLD_DONE_INT_CLR.description: The bit is used to clear interrupt that occurs only when L2-Cache preload-operation is done.

L2_CACHE_PLD_ERR_INT_CLR.description: The bit is used to clear interrupt of L2-Cache preload-operation error.

L2_CACHE_SYNC_PRELOAD_INT_RAW.description: Sync Preload operation Interrupt raw register

L2_CACHE_PLD_DONE_INT_RAW.description: The raw bit of the interrupt that occurs only when L2-Cache preload-operation is done.

L2_CACHE_PLD_ERR_INT_RAW.description: The raw bit of the interrupt that occurs only when L2-Cache preload-operation error occurs.

L2_CACHE_SYNC_PRELOAD_INT_ST.description: L1-Cache Access Fail Interrupt status register

L2_CACHE_PLD_DONE_INT_ST.description: The bit indicates the status of the interrupt that occurs only when L2-Cache preload-operation is done.

L2_CACHE_PLD_ERR_INT_ST.description: The bit indicates the status of the interrupt of L2-Cache preload-operation error.

L2_CACHE_PLD_ERR_CODE.description: The value 2 is Only available which means preload size is error in L2-Cache.

L2_CACHE_SYNC_RST.description: set this bit to reset sync-logic inside L2-Cache. Recommend that this should only be used to initialize sync-logic when some fatal error of sync-logic occurs.

L2_CACHE_PLD_RST.description: set this bit to reset preload-logic inside L2-Cache. Recommend that this should only be used to initialize preload-logic when some fatal error of preload-logic occurs.

L2_CACHE_AUTOLOAD_BUF_CLR_CTRL.description: Cache Autoload buffer clear control register

L2_CACHE_ALD_BUF_CLR.description: set this bit to clear autoload-buffer inside L2-Cache. If this bit is active, autoload will not work in L2-Cache. This bit should not be active when autoload works in L2-Cache.

L2_CACHE_UNALLOC_CLR.description: The bit is used to clear the unallocate request buffer of l2 icache where the unallocate request is responsed but not completed.

L2_CACHE_ACCESS_ATTR_CTRL.description: L2 cache access attribute control register

L2_CACHE_ACCESS_FORCE_CC.description: Set this bit to force the request to l2 cache with cacheable attribute, otherwise, the attribute is propagated from L1 cache or CPU, it could be one of cacheable and non-cacheable.

L2_CACHE_ACCESS_FORCE_WB.description: Set this bit to force the request to l2 cache with write-back attribute, otherwise, the attribute is propagated from L1 cache or CPU, it could be one of write-back and write-through.

L2_CACHE_ACCESS_FORCE_WMA.description: Set this bit to force the request to l2 cache with write-miss-allocate attribute, otherwise, the attribute is propagated from L1 cache or CPU, it could be one of write-miss-allocate and write-miss-no-allocate.

L2_CACHE_ACCESS_FORCE_RMA.description: Set this bit to force the request to l2 cache with read-miss-allocate attribute, otherwise, the attribute is propagated from L1 cache or CPU, it could be one of read-miss-allocate and read-miss-no-allocate.

DIS_USB_SERIAL_JTAG.description: Represents whether USB-Serial-JTAG is disabled or enabled. 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

SPI_DOWNLOAD_MSPI_DIS.description: Set this bit to disable accessing MSPI flash/MSPI ram by SYS AXI matrix during boot_mode_download.

DIS_TWAI.description: Represents whether TWAI function is disabled or enabled. 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

JTAG_SEL_ENABLE.description: Represents whether the selection between usb_to_jtag and pad_to_jtag through strapping gpio15 when both EFUSE_DIS_PAD_JTAG and EFUSE_DIS_USB_JTAG are equal to 0 is enabled or disabled. 1: enabled. 0: disabled.

SOFT_DIS_JTAG.description: Represents whether JTAG is disabled in soft way. Odd number: disabled. Even number: enabled.

DIS_PAD_JTAG.description: Represents whether JTAG is disabled in the hard way(permanently). 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

DIS_DOWNLOAD_MANUAL_ENCRYPT.description: Represents whether flash encrypt function is disabled or enabled(except in SPI boot mode). 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

USB_OTG11_DREFH.description: USB intphy of usb otg11 signle-end input high threshold, 1.76V to 2V. Step by 80mV

KM_HUK_GEN_STATE_LOW.description: Set this bit to control validation of HUK generate mode. Odd of 1 is invalid, even of 1 is valid.

KM_HUK_GEN_STATE_HIGH.description: Set this bit to control validation of HUK generate mode. Odd of 1 is invalid, even of 1 is valid.

KM_RND_SWITCH_CYCLE.description: Set bits to control key manager random number switch cycle. 0: control by register. 1: 8 km clk cycles. 2: 16 km cycles. 3: 32 km cycles.

KM_DEPLOY_ONLY_ONCE.description: Set each bit to control whether corresponding key can only be deployed once. 1 is true, 0 is false. Bit0: ecdsa. Bit1: xts. Bit2: hmac. Bit3: ds.

FORCE_USE_KEY_MANAGER_KEY.description: Set each bit to control whether corresponding key must come from key manager.. 1 is true, 0 is false. Bit0: ecdsa. Bit1: xts. Bit2: hmac. Bit3: ds.

FORCE_DISABLE_SW_INIT_KEY.description: Set this bit to disable software written init key, and force use efuse_init_key.

XTS_KEY_LENGTH_256.description: Set this bit to configure flash encryption use xts-128 key, else use xts-256 key.

WDT_DELAY_SEL.description: Represents whether RTC watchdog timeout threshold is selected at startup. 1: selected. 0: not selected.

SPI_BOOT_CRYPT_CNT.description: Represents whether SPI boot encrypt/decrypt is disabled or enabled. Odd number of 1: enabled. Even number of 1: disabled.

SECURE_BOOT_KEY_REVOKE0.description: Represents whether revoking first secure boot key is enabled or disabled. 1: enabled. 0: disabled.

SECURE_BOOT_KEY_REVOKE1.description: Represents whether revoking second secure boot key is enabled or disabled. 1: enabled. 0: disabled.

SECURE_BOOT_KEY_REVOKE2.description: Represents whether revoking third secure boot key is enabled or disabled. 1: enabled. 0: disabled.

SEC_DPA_LEVEL.description: Represents the spa secure level by configuring the clock random divide mode.

ECDSA_ENABLE_SOFT_K.description: Represents whether hardware random number k is forced used in ESDCA. 1: force used. 0: not force used.

CRYPT_DPA_ENABLE.description: Represents whether anti-dpa attack is enabled. 1:enabled. 0: disabled.

SECURE_BOOT_EN.description: Represents whether secure boot is enabled or disabled. 1: enabled. 0: disabled.

SECURE_BOOT_AGGRESSIVE_REVOKE.description: Represents whether revoking aggressive secure boot is enabled or disabled. 1: enabled. 0: disabled.

FLASH_TYPE.description: The type of interfaced flash. 0: four data lines, 1: eight data lines.

FLASH_ECC_EN.description: Set this bit to enable ecc for flash boot.

DIS_USB_OTG_DOWNLOAD_MODE.description: Set this bit to disable download via USB-OTG.

FLASH_TPUW.description: Represents the flash waiting time after power-up, in unit of ms. When the value less than 15, the waiting time is the programmed value. Otherwise, the waiting time is 2 times the programmed value.

DIS_DOWNLOAD_MODE.description: Represents whether Download mode is disabled or enabled. 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

DIS_DIRECT_BOOT.description: Represents whether direct boot mode is disabled or enabled. 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

DIS_USB_SERIAL_JTAG_ROM_PRINT.description: Represents whether print from USB-Serial-JTAG is disabled or enabled. 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

DIS_USB_SERIAL_JTAG_DOWNLOAD_MODE.description: Represents whether the USB-Serial-JTAG download function is disabled or enabled. 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

ENABLE_SECURITY_DOWNLOAD.description: Represents whether security download is enabled or disabled. 1: enabled. 0: disabled.

UART_PRINT_CONTROL.description: Represents the type of UART printing. 00: force enable printing. 01: enable printing when GPIO8 is reset at low level. 10: enable printing when GPIO8 is reset at high level. 11: force disable printing.

FORCE_SEND_RESUME.description: Represents whether ROM code is forced to send a resume command during SPI boot. 1: forced. 0:not forced.

SECURE_VERSION.description: Represents the version used by ESP-IDF anti-rollback feature.

SECURE_BOOT_DISABLE_FAST_WAKE.description: Represents whether FAST VERIFY ON WAKE is disabled or enabled when Secure Boot is enabled. 1: disabled. 0: enabled.

HYS_EN_PAD.description: Represents whether the hysteresis function of corresponding PAD is enabled. 1: enabled. 0:disabled.

USB_DEVICE_DREFL.description: Represents the usb device single-end input low threhold, 0.8 V to 1.04 V with step of 80 mV.

USB_OTG11_DREFL.description: Represents the usb otg11 single-end input low threhold, 0.8 V to 1.04 V with step of 80 mV.

HP_PWR_SRC_SEL.description: HP system power source select. 0:LDO. 1: DCDC.

DIS_WDT.description: Set this bit to disable watch dog.

DIS_SWD.description: Set this bit to disable super-watchdog.

FRAME_START.description: Configures whether or not to start encoding one frame.\\0: Invalid. No effect\\1: Start encoding one frame

DMA_MOVE_START.description: Configures whether or not to start moving reference data from external mem.\\0: Invalid. No effect\\1: H264 start moving two MB lines of reference frame from external mem to internal mem

FRAME_MODE.description: Configures H264 running mode. When field H264_DUAL_STREAM_MODE is set to 1, this field must be set to 1 too.\\0: GOP mode. Before every GOP first frame start, need reconfig reference frame DMA\\1: Frame mode. Before every frame start, need reconfig reference frame DMA

SYS_RST_PULSE.description: Configures whether or not to reset H264 ip.\\0: Invalid. No effect\\1: Reset H264 ip

DUAL_STREAM_MODE.description: Configures whether or not to enable dual stream mode. When this field is set to 1,  H264_FRAME_MODE field must be set to 1 too.\\0: Normal mode\\1: Dual stream mode

GOP_NUM.description: Configures the frame number of one GOP.\\0: The frame number of one GOP is infinite\\Others: Actual frame number of one GOP

Configures the low level width of the SCL Clock. 
Measurement unit: i2c_sclk.

SDA_FORCE_OUT.description:
Configures the SDA output mode
1: Direct output,

0: Open drain output.

SCL_FORCE_OUT.description:
Configures the SCL output mode
1: Direct output,

0: Open drain output.

SAMPLE_SCL_LEVEL.description:
Configures the sample mode for SDA.
1: Sample SDA data on the SCL low level.

0: Sample SDA data on the SCL high level.

RX_FULL_ACK_LEVEL.description: Configures the ACK value that needs to be sent by master when the rx_fifo_cnt has reached the threshold.

MS_MODE.description:
Configures the module as an I2C Master or Slave. 
0: Slave

1: Master

TRANS_START.description:
Configures to start sending the data in txfifo for slave. 
0: No effect

1: Start

TX_LSB_FIRST.description:
Configures to control the sending order for data needing to be sent. 
1: send data from the least significant bit,

0: send data from the most significant bit.

RX_LSB_FIRST.description:
Configures to control the storage order for received data.
1: receive data from the least significant bit

0: receive data from the most significant bit.

CLK_EN.description:
Configures whether to gate clock signal for registers.

0: Force clock on for registers 

1: Support clock only when registers are read or written to by software.

ARBITRATION_EN.description:
Configures to enable I2C bus arbitration detection.
0: No effect

1: Enable

FSM_RST.description:
Configures to reset the SCL_FSM.
0: No effect

1: Reset

CONF_UPGATE.description:
Configures this bit for synchronization
0: No effect

1: Synchronize

SLV_TX_AUTO_START_EN.description:
Configures to enable slave to send data automatically
0: Disable

1: Enable

ADDR_10BIT_RW_CHECK_EN.description:
Configures to check if the r/w bit of 10bit addressing consists with I2C protocol.
0: Not check

1: Check

ADDR_BROADCASTING_EN.description:
Configures to support the 7bit general call function. 
0: Not support

1: Support

RESP_REC.description:
Represents the received ACK value in master mode or slave mode.
0: ACK,

1: NACK.

SLAVE_RW.description:
Represents the transfer direction in slave mode,.
1: Master reads from slave,

0: Master writes to slave.

ARB_LOST.description:
Represents whether the I2C controller loses control of SCL line.
0: No arbitration lost

1: Arbitration lost

BUS_BUSY.description:
Represents the I2C bus state.
1: The I2C bus is busy transferring data, 

0: The I2C bus is in idle state.

SLAVE_ADDRESSED.description:
Represents whether the address sent by the master is equal to the address of the slave.
Valid only when the module is configured as an I2C Slave.
0: Not equal

1: Equal

RXFIFO_CNT.description: Represents the number of data bytes to be sent.

STRETCH_CAUSE.description:
Represents the cause of SCL clocking stretching in slave mode.
0: Stretching SCL low when the master starts to read data.

1: Stretching SCL low when I2C TX FIFO is empty in slave mode.

2: Stretching SCL low when I2C RX FIFO is full in slave mode.

TXFIFO_CNT.description: Represents the number of data bytes received in RAM.

SCL_MAIN_STATE_LAST.description:
Represents the states of the I2C module state machine. 
0: Idle,

1: Address shift,

2: ACK address,

3: Rx data,

4: Tx data,

5: Send ACK,

6: Wait ACK

SCL_STATE_LAST.description:
Represents the states of the state machine used to produce SCL.
0: Idle,

1: Start,

2: Negative edge,

3: Low,

4: Positive edge,

5: High,

6: Stop

TO.description: Setting time out control for receiving data.

TIME_OUT_VALUE.description:
Configures the timeout threshold period for SCL stucking at high or low level. The actual period is 2^(reg_time_out_value).
Measurement unit: i2c_sclk.

TIME_OUT_EN.description:
Configures to enable time out control.
0: No effect

1: Enable

SLAVE_ADDR.description: Configure the slave address of I2C Slave.

ADDR_10BIT_EN.description:
Configures to enable the slave 10-bit addressing mode in master mode. 
0: No effect

1: Enable

SLAVE_RW_POINT.description: Represents the offset address in the I2C Slave RAM addressed by I2C Master when in I2C slave mode.

RXFIFO_WM_THRHD.description: Configures the water mark threshold of RXFIFO in nonfifo access mode. When reg_reg_fifo_prt_en is 1 and rx FIFO counter is bigger than reg_rxfifo_wm_thrhd[4:0], reg_rxfifo_wm_int_raw bit will be valid.

TXFIFO_WM_THRHD.description: Configures the water mark threshold of TXFIFO in nonfifo access mode. When reg_reg_fifo_prt_en is 1 and tx FIFO counter is smaller than reg_txfifo_wm_thrhd[4:0], reg_txfifo_wm_int_raw bit will be valid.

NONFIFO_EN.description: Configures to enable APB nonfifo access.

FIFO_ADDR_CFG_EN.description:
Configures to enable double addressing mode. When this mode is enabled, the byte received after the I2C address byte represents the offset address in the I2C Slave RAM. 
0: Disable

1: Enable

TX_FIFO_RST.description:

FIFO_PRT_EN.description:

COMMAND0.description:
Configures command 0. It consists of three parts: 
op_code is the command,
0: RSTART, 
1: WRITE,
2: READ,
3: STOP,
4: END.

Byte_num represents the number of bytes that need to be sent or received.
ack_check_en, ack_exp and ack are used to control the ACK bit. See I2C cmd structure for more information.

Configures the threshold value of SCL_FSM state unchanged period. It should be no more than 23.

SCL_MAIN_ST_TIME_OUT.description: SCL main status time out register

SCL_MAIN_ST_TO_I2C.description:

SCL_RST_SLV_NUM.description:
Configure the pulses of SCL generated in I2C master mode. 
Valid when reg_scl_rst_slv_en is 1.

SCL_PD_EN.description:
Configures to power down the I2C output SCL line. 
0: Not power down.

1: Power down.

SDA_PD_EN.description:
Configures to power down the I2C output SDA line.

1: Power down.

SCL_STRETCH_CONF.description: Set SCL stretch of I2C slave

STRETCH_PROTECT_NUM.description:
Configures the time period to release the SCL line from stretching to avoid timing violation. Usually it should be larger than the SDA setup time.
Measurement unit: i2c_sclk

SLAVE_SCL_STRETCH_EN.description:
Configures to enable slave SCL stretch function.
0: Disable

1: Enable
The SCL output line will be stretched low when reg_slave_scl_stretch_en is 1 and stretch event happens. The stretch cause can be seen in reg_stretch_cause.

SLAVE_SCL_STRETCH_CLR.description:
Configures to clear the I2C slave SCL stretch function.
0: No effect

1: Clear

SLAVE_BYTE_ACK_CTL_EN.description:
Configures to enable the function for slave to control ACK level.
0: Disable

1: Enable

SLAVE_BYTE_ACK_LVL.description:
Set the ACK level when slave controlling ACK level function enables.
0: Low level

1: High level

TX_PCM_BYPASS.description: Set this bit to bypass  Compress/Decompress module for transmitted data.

TX_MSB_SHIFT.description: Set this bit to enable transmitter in Phillips standard mode

TX_BCK_NO_DLY.description: 1: BCK is not delayed to generate pos/neg edge in master mode. 0: BCK is delayed to generate pos/neg edge in master mode.

TX_LEFT_ALIGN.description: 1: I2S TX left alignment mode. 0: I2S TX right alignment mode.

TX_24_FILL_EN.description: 1: Sent 32 bits in 24 channel bits mode. 0: Sent 24 bits in 24 channel bits mode

TX_WS_IDLE_POL.description: 0: WS should be 0 when sending left channel data, and WS is 1in right channel.  1: WS should be 1 when sending left channel data, and WS is 0in right channel.

TX_BIT_ORDER.description: I2S Tx bit endian. 1:small endian, the LSB is sent first. 0:big endian, the MSB is sent first.

TX_TDM_EN.description: 1: Enable I2S TDM Tx mode . 0: Disable.

TX_PDM_EN.description: 1: Enable I2S PDM Tx mode . 0: Disable.

TX_BCK_DIV_NUM.description: Bit clock configuration bits in transmitter mode.

TX_CHAN_MOD.description: I2S transmitter channel mode configuration bits.

SIG_LOOPBACK.description: Enable signal loop back mode with transmitter module and receiver module sharing the same WS and BCK signals.

RX_TDM_WS_WIDTH.description: The width of rx_ws_out at idle level in TDM mode is (I2S_RX_TDM_WS_WIDTH[8:0] +1) * T_bck

RX_BITS_MOD.description: Set the bits to configure the valid data bit length of I2S receiver channel. 7: all the valid channel data is in 8-bit-mode. 15: all the valid channel data is in 16-bit-mode. 23: all the valid channel data is in 24-bit-mode. 31:all the valid channel data is in 32-bit-mode.

RX_TDM_CHAN_BITS.description: The Rx bit number for each channel minus 1in TDM mode.

TX_TDM_WS_WIDTH.description: The width of tx_ws_out at idle level in TDM mode is (I2S_TX_TDM_WS_WIDTH[8:0] +1) * T_bck

TX_BITS_MOD.description: Set the bits to configure the valid data bit length of I2S transmitter channel. 7: all the valid channel data is in 8-bit-mode. 15: all the valid channel data is in 16-bit-mode. 23: all the valid channel data is in 24-bit-mode. 31:all the valid channel data is in 32-bit-mode.

TX_TDM_CHAN_BITS.description: The Tx bit number for each channel minus 1in TDM mode.

TX_PDM_HP_BYPASS.description: I2S TX PDM bypass hp filter or not. The option has been removed.

TX_PDM_PRESCALE.description: I2S TX PDM prescale for sigmadelta

LC_FIFO_TIMEOUT.description: the i2s_tx_hung_int interrupt or the i2s_rx_hung_int interrupt will be triggered when fifo hung counter is equal to this value

LC_FIFO_TIMEOUT_SHIFT.description: The bits are used to scale tick counter threshold. The tick counter is reset when counter value >= 88000/2^i2s_lc_fifo_timeout_shift

LC_FIFO_TIMEOUT_ENA.description: The enable bit for FIFO timeout

RXEOF_NUM.description: I2S RX data number control register.

RX_EOF_NUM.description: The receive data bit length is (I2S_RX_BITS_MOD[4:0] + 1) * (REG_RX_EOF_NUM[11:0] + 1) . It will trigger in_suc_eof interrupt in the configured DMA RX channel.

SINGLE_DATA.description: The configured constant channel data to be sent out.

TX_IDLE.description: 1: i2s_tx is idle state. 0: i2s_tx is working.

ETM_TX_SEND_WORD_NUM.description: I2S ETM send x words event. When sending word number of reg_etm_tx_send_word_num[9:0], i2s will trigger an etm event.

ETM_RX_RECEIVE_WORD_NUM.description: I2S ETM receive x words event. When receiving word number of reg_etm_rx_receive_word_num[9:0], i2s will trigger an etm event.

TX_FIFO_CNT_RST.description: Set this bit to reset tx fifo counter.

TX_BCK_CNT_RST.description: Set this bit to reset tx bck counter.

CLK_EN.description: set this bit to enable clock gate

DEVICE_CTRL.description: DEVICE_CTRL register controls the transfer properties and disposition of controllers capabilities.

REG_BA_INCLUDE.description: This bit is used to include I3C broadcast address(0x7E) for private transfer.(If I3C broadcast address is not include for the private transfer, In-Band Interrupts driven from Slaves may not win address arbitration. Hence IBIs will get delayed)

REG_MULTI_SLV_SINGLE_CCC_EN.description: 0: rx high bit first, 1: rx low bit first

REG_RX_BIT_ORDER.description: 0: rx low byte fist, 1: rx high byte first

REG_SCL_PULLUP_FORCE_EN.description: This bit is used to force scl_pullup_en

REG_SCL_OE_FORCE_EN.description: This bit is used to force scl_oe

REG_DATA_BYTE_CNT_UNLATCH.description: 1: read current real-time updated value  0: read latch data byte cnt value

REG_MEM_CLK_FORCE_ON.description: 1: dev characteristic and address table memory clk  date force on . 0 :  clock gating by rd/wr.

BUFFER_THLD_CTRL.description: In-Band Interrupt Status Threshold Value . Every In Band Interrupt received by I3C controller generates an IBI status. This field controls the number of IBI status entries in the IBI buffer that trigger the IBI_STATUS_THLD_STAT interrupt.

REG_CMD_BUF_EMPTY_THLD.description: Command Buffer Empty Threshold Value is used to control the number of empty locations(or greater) in the Command Buffer that trigger CMD_BUFFER_READY_STAT interrupt.

REG_RESP_BUF_THLD.description: Response Buffer Threshold Value is used to control the number of entries in the Response Buffer that trigger the RESP_READY_STAT_INTR.

REG_IBI_DATA_BUF_THLD.description: In-Band Interrupt Data Threshold Value . Every In Band Interrupt received by I3C controller generates an IBI status. This field controls the number of IBI data entries in the IBI buffer that trigger the IBI_DATA_THLD_STAT interrupt.

REG_TX_DATA_BUF_THLD.description: Transmit Buffer Threshold Value. This field controls the number of empty locations in the Transmit FIFO that trigger the TX_THLD_STAT interrupt. Supports values: 000:2  001:4  010:8  011:16  100:31, else:31

REG_RX_DATA_BUF_THLD.description: Receive Buffer Threshold Value. This field controls the number of empty locations in the Receive FIFO that trigger the RX_THLD_STAT interrupt. Supports: 000:2  001:4  010:8  011:16  100:31, else:31

REG_NOTIFY_SIR_REJECTED.description: Notify Rejected Slave Interrupt Request Control. This bit is used to suppress reporting to the application about Slave Interrupt Request. 0:Suppress passing the IBI Status to the IBI FIFO(hence not notifying the application) when a SIR request is NACKed and auto-disabled base on the IBI_SIR_REQ_REJECT register. 1: Writes IBI Status to the IBI FIFO(hence notifying the application) when SIR request is NACKed and auto-disabled based on the IBI_SIR_REQ_REJECT registerl.

REG_SIR_REQ_REJECT.description: The application of controller can decide whether to send ACK or NACK for Slave request received from any I3C device. A device specific response control bit is provided to select the response option, Master will ACK/NACK the Master Request based on programming of control bit, corresponding to the interrupting device. 0:ACK the SIR Request  1:NACK and send direct auto disable CCC

TX_DATA_BUF_THLD_INT_ST.description: This interrupt is generated when number of empty locations in transmit buffer is greater than or equal to threshold value specified by TX_EMPTY_BUS_THLD field in DATA_BUFFER_THLD_CTRL register. This interrupt will be cleared automatically when number of empty locations in transmit buffer is less than threshold value.

RX_DATA_BUF_THLD_INT_ST.description: This interrupt is generated when number of entries in receive buffer is greater than or equal to threshold value specified by RX_BUF_THLD field in DATA_BUFFER_THLD_CTRL register. This interrupt will be cleared automatically when number of entries in receive buffer is less than threshold value.

IBI_STATUS_THLD_INT_ST.description: Only used in master mode. This interrupt is generated when number of entries in IBI buffer is greater than or equal to threshold value specified by IBI_BUF_THLD field in BUFFER_THLD_CTRL register. This interrupt will be cleared automatically when number of entries in IBI buffer is less than threshold value.

CMD_BUF_EMPTY_THLD_INT_ST.description: This interrupt is generated when number of empty locations in command buffer is greater than or equal to threshold value specified by CMD_EMPTY_BUF_THLD field in BUFFER_THLD_CTRL register. This interrupt will be cleared automatically when number of empty locations in command buffer is less than threshold value.

RESP_READY_INT_ST.description: This interrupt is generated when number of entries in response buffer is greater than or equal to threshold value specified by RESP_BUF_THLD field in BUFFER_THLD_CTRL register. This interrupt will be cleared automatically when number of entries in response buffer is less than threshold value.

NXT_CMD_REQ_ERR_INT_ST.description: This interrupt is generated if toc is 0(master will restart next command), but command buf is empty.

TRANSFER_ERR_INT_ST.description: This interrupt is generated if any error occurs during transfer. The error type will be specified in the response packet associated with the command (in ERR_STATUS field of RESPONSE_BUFFER_PORT register). This bit can be cleared by writing 1'h1.

INT_ST_ENA.description: The Interrupt status will be updated in INTR_STATUS register if corresponding Status Enable bit set.

IBI_STATUS_THLD_INT_ENA.description: Only used in master mode. IBI Buffer threshold status enable.

NXT_CMD_REQ_ERR_INT_ENA.description: next command request error status enable

BUFFER_STATUS_LEVEL.description: BUFFER_STATUS_LEVEL reflects the status level of Buffers in the controller.

CMD_BUF_EMPTY_CNT.description: Command Buffer Empty Locations contains the number of empty locations in the command buffer.

RESP_BUF_CNT.description: Response Buffer Level Value contains the number of valid data entries in the response buffer.

IBI_DATA_BUF_CNT.description: IBI Buffer Level Value contains the number of valid entries in the IBI Buffer. This is field is used in master mode.

IBI_STATUS_BUF_CNT.description: IBI Buffer Status Count contains the number of IBI status entries in the IBI Buffer. This field is used in master mode.

DATA_BUFFER_STATUS_LEVEL.description: DATA_BUFFER_STATUS_LEVEL reflects the status level of the Buffers in the controller.

TX_DATA_BUF_EMPTY_CNT.description: Transmit Buffer Empty Level Value contains the number of empty locations in the transmit Buffer.

RX_DATA_BUF_CNT.description: Receive Buffer Level value contains the number of valid data entries in the receive buffer.

SDA_LVL.description: This bit is used to check the SCL line level to recover from error and  for debugging. This bit reflects the value of synchronized scl_in_a.

SCL_LVL.description: This bit is used to check the SDA line level to recover from error and  for debugging. This bit reflects the value of synchronized sda_in_a.

DAA_MODE_FSM_STATE.description: Reflects whether the Master Controller is in IDLE or not. This bit will be set when all the buffer(Command, Response, IBI, Transmit, Receive) are empty along with the Master State machine is in idle state. 0X0: not in idle  0x1: in idle

DATA_BYTE_CNT.description: Present transfer data byte cnt: tx data byte cnt if write  rx data byte cnt if read  ibi data byte cnt if IBI handle.

REG_I3C_MST_OD_LOW_PERIOD.description: SCL Open-Drain low count for I3C transfers targeted to I3C devices.

REG_I3C_MST_OD_HIGH_PERIOD.description: SCL Open-Drain High count for I3C transfers targeted to I3C devices.

REG_I2C_FM_HIGH_PERIOD.description: The SCL open-drain low count timing for I2C Fast Mode transfers.

REG_SDA_OD_SAMPLE_TIME.description: It is used to adjust sda sample point when scl high under open drain speed

REG_SDA_PP_SAMPLE_TIME.description: It is used to adjust sda sample point when scl high under push pull speed

REG_SDA_OD_TX_HOLD_TIME.description: It is used to adjust sda drive point after scl neg under open drain speed

REG_SDA_PP_TX_HOLD_TIME.description: It is used to adjust sda dirve point after scl neg under push pull speed

REG_BUS_FREE_TIME.description: I3C Bus Free Count Value. This field is used only in Master mode. In pure Bus System, this field represents tCAS.  In Mixed Bus System, this field is expected to be programmed to tLOW of I2C Timing.

REG_I3C_MST_VER_ID.description: This field indicates the controller current release number that is read by an application.

REG_I3C_MST_VER_TYPE.description: This field indicates the controller current release type that is read by an application.

REG_I3C_MST_FPGA_DEBUG_PROBE.description: For Debug Probe Test on FPGA

REG_COMMAND.description: Contains a Command Descriptor structure that depends on the requested transfer type. Command Descriptor structure is used to schedule the transfers to devices on I3C bus.

RESPONSE.description: The Response Buffer can be read through this register. The response status for each Command is written into the Response Buffer by the controller if ROC (Response On Completion) bit is set or if transfer error has occurred. The response buffer can be read through this register.

RX_DATA_PORT.description: Receive Data Port. Receive data is mapped to the Rx-data buffer and receive data is always packed in 4-byte aligned data words.  If the length of data transfer is not aligned to 4-bytes boundary, then there will be extra(unused) bytes(the additional data bytes have to be ignored) at the end of the transferred data. The valid data must be identified using the DATA_LENGTH filed in the Response Descriptor.

REG_TX_DATA_PORT.description: Transmit Data Port. Transmit data is mapped to the Tx-data  buffer and transmit data is always packed in 4-byte aligned data words.  If the length of data transfer is not aligned to 4-bytes boundary, then there will be extra(unused) bytes(the additional data bytes have to be ignored) at the end of the transferred data. The valid data must be identified using the DATA_LENGTH filed in the Response Descriptor.

IBI_STATUS_BUF.description: In-Band Interrupt Buffer Status/Data Register. When receiving an IBI, IBI_PORT is used to both: Read the IBI Status Read the IBI Data(which is raw/opaque data)

DATA_LENGTH.description: This field represents the length of data received along with IBI, in bytes.

IBI_ID.description: IBI Identifier. The byte received after START which includes the address the R/W bit: Device  address and R/W bit in case of Slave Interrupt or Master Request.

IBI_STS.description: IBI received data/status. IBI Data register is mapped to the IBI Buffer. The IBI Data is always packed in4-byte aligned and put to the IBI Buffer. This register When read from, reads the data from the IBI buffer. IBI Status register when read from, returns the data from the IBI Buffer and indicates how the controller responded to incoming IBI(SIR, MR and HJ).

REG_DAT_DEV1_DYNAMIC_ADDR.description: Device Dynamic Address with parity, The MSB,bit[23], should be programmed with parity of dynamic address.

REG_DAT_DEV1_NACK_RETRY_CNT.description: This field is used to set the Device NACK Retry count for the particular device. If the Device NACK's for the device address, the controller automatically retries the same device until this count expires. If the Slave does not ACK for the mentioned number of retries, then controller generates an error response and move to the Halt state.

REG_DAT_DEV1_I2C.description: Legacy I2C device or not. This bit should be set to 1 if the device is a legacy I2C device.

If the Device NACK's for the device address, the controller automatically retries the same device until this count expires. If the Slave does not ACK for the mentioned number of retries, then controller generates an error response and move to the Halt state.

REG_DAT_DEV7_I2C.description: Legacy I2C device or not. This bit should be set to 1 if the device is a legacy I2C device.

SLVENA.description: 1: allow the slave to operate on i2c or i3c bus. 0: the slave will ignore the bus. This should be not set until registers such as PARTNO, IDEXT and the like are set 1st  -if used- since they impact data to the master

NACK.description: 1:the slave will NACK all requests to it except CCC broadcast. This should be used with caution as the Master may determine the slave is missing if overused.

MATCHSS.description: 1: the START and STOP sticky STATUS bits will only be set if MATCHED is set..This allows START and STOP to be used to detect end of a message to /from this slave.

S0IGNORE.description: If 1, the Slave will not detect S0 or S1 errors and so not lock up waiting on an Exit Pattern. This should only be used when the bus will not use HDR.

BAMATCH.description: Bus Available condition match value for current ???Slow clock???. This provides the count of the slow clock to count out 1us (or more) to allow an IBI to drive SDA Low when the Master is not doing so. The max width , and so max value, is controlled by the block. Only if enabled for events such IBI or MR or HJ, and if enabled to provide this as a register. With is limited to CLK_SLOW_BITS

SADDR.description: If allowed by the block:sets i2c 7 bits static address,else should be 0. If enabled to use one and to be provided by SW. Block may provide in HW as well.

STNOTSTOP.description: Is 1 if bus is busy(activity) and 0 when in a STOP condition. Other bits may also set when busy. Note that this can also be true from an S0 or S1 error, which waits for an Exit Pattern.

STMSG.description: Is 1 if this bus Slave is listening to the bus traffic or repsonding, If STNOSTOP=1, then this will be 0 when a non-matching address seen until next respeated START it STOP.

STCCCH.description: Is 1 if a CCC message is being handled automatically.

STREQRD.description: 1 if the req in process is an sdr read from this slave or an IBI is being pushed out,

RXPEND.description: Receiving a message from master,which is not being handled by block(not a CCC internally processed). For all but External FIFO, this uses DATACTRL RXTRIG, which defaults to not-empty. If DMA is enabled for RX, DMA will be signaled as well. Will self-clear if data is read(FIFO and non-FIFO)

TXNOTFULL.description: Is 1 when the To-bus buffer/FIFO can accept more data to go out. Defau:1. For all but External FIFO, this uses DATACTRL TXTRIG,which defaults to not-full. If DMA is enabled for TX, it will also be signaled to provide more.

DACHG.description: The Slv Dynamic Address has been assigned, reassigned, or reset(lost) and is now in that state of being valid or none. Actual DA can be seen in the DYNADDR register. Note that this will also be used when MAP Auto feature is configured. This will be changing one or more MAP items. See DYNADDR and/or MAPCTRLn. DYNAADDR for the main DA(0) will indicate if last change was due to Auto MAP.

CCC.description: A common -command-code(CCC), not handled by block, has been received. This acts differently between: *Broadcasted ones, which will then also correspond with RXPEND and the 1st byte will be the CCC(command) . *Direct ones, which may never be directed to this device.  If it is, then the TXSEND or RXPEND will be triggered with this end the RXPEND will contain the command.

SLV_EVENT.description: If set to non-0, will request an event. Once requested, STATUS.EVENT and EVDET will show the status as it progresses. Once completed, the field will automatically return to 0. Once non-0, only 0 can be written(to cancel) until done. 0: Normal mode. If set to 0 after was a non-0 value, will cancel if not already in flight. 1: start an IBI. This will try to push through an IBI on the bus. If data associate with the IBI, it will be drawn from the IBIDATA field. Note that if Time control is enabled, this will include anytime control related bytes  further, the IBIDATA byte will have bit7 set to 1.

MAPIDX.description: Index of Dynamic Address that IBI is for. This is 0 for the main or base Dynamic Address, or can be any valid index.

IBIDATA.description: Data byte to go with an IBI, if enabled for it. If enabled (was in BCR), then it is required.

PENDINT.description: Should be set to the pending interrupt that GETSTATUS CCC will return. This should be maintained by the application if used and configured, as the Master will read this. If not configured, the GETSTATUS field will return 1 if an IBI is pending, and 0 otherwise.

INTSET.description: INSET allows setting enables for interrupts(connecting the corresponding STATUS source to causing an IRQ to the processor)

STOP_ENA.description: Interrupt on STOP state on the bus. See Start as the preferred interrupt when needed. This interrupt may not trigger for quick STOP/START combination, as it relates to the state of being stopped.

RXPEND_ENA.description: Interrupt when receiving a message from Master, which is not being handled by the block (excludes CCCs being handled automatically). If FIFO, then RX fullness trigger. If DMA, then message end.

STOP_CLR.description: Interrupt on STOP state on the bus. See Start as the preferred interrupt when needed. This interrupt may not trigger for quick STOP/START combination, as it relates to the state of being stopped.

RXPEND_CLR.description: Interrupt when receiving a message from Master, which is not being handled by the block (excludes CCCs being handled automatically). If FIFO, then RX fullness trigger. If DMA, then message end.

STOP_MASK.description: Interrupt on STOP state on the bus. See Start as the preferred interrupt when needed. This interrupt may not trigger for quick STOP/START combination, as it relates to the state of being stopped.

RXPEND_MASK.description: Interrupt when receiving a message from Master, which is not being handled by the block (excludes CCCs being handled automatically). If FIFO, then RX fullness trigger. If DMA, then message end.

FLUSHTB.description: Flushes the from-bus buffer/FIFO. Not normally used

FLUSHFB.description: Flushes the to-bus buffer/FIFO. Used when Master terminates a to-bus (read) message prematurely

UNLOCK.description: If this bit is not written 1, the register bits from 7 to 4 are not changed on write.

TXTRIG.description: Trigger level for tx emptiness when FIFOed, Affects interrupt and DMA(if enabled). The defaults is 3

RXTRIG.description: Trigger level for rx fulless when FIFOed, Affects interrupt and DMA(if enabled). The defaults is 3

DATA0.description: This register allows reading a byte from the bus unless external FIFO is used. A byte should not be read unless there is data waiting, as indicated by the RXPEND bit being set in the STATUS register

DATA_MSB.description: This register allows reading a Half-word (byte pair)  from the bus unless external FIFO is used. A Half-word should not be read unless there is at least 2 bytes of data waiting, as indicated by the RX FIFO level trigger or RXCOUNT available space in the DATACTRL register

SHARP_MATRIX_Y_MEM_AUX_CTRL.description: this field configures the mem_aux of sharp y line buffer memory

DEMOSAIC_MATRIX_MEM_AUX_CTRL.description: this field configures the mem_aux of demosaic line buffer memory

SHARP_MATRIX_UV_MEM_AUX_CTRL.description: this field configures the mem_aux of sharp uv line buffer memory

YUV_MODE.description: this bit configures the yuv mode. 0: ITU-R BT.601, 1: ITU-R BT.709

YUV_RANGE.description: this bit configures the yuv range. 0: full range, 1: limit range

JPEG_START.description: start to compress a new pic(in dma reg mode)

DEBUG_DIRECT_OUT_EN.description: 0:normal mode,1:debug mode for direct output from input

GRAY_SEL.description: 0:use non-fifo way to access qnr ram,1:use fifo way to access qnr ram

DHT_FIFO_EN.description: 0:use non-fifo way to write dht len_total/codemin/value table,1:use fifo way to write dht len_total/codemin/value table. Reading dht len_total/codemin/value table only has nonfifo way

JFIF_VER.description: decode pause period to trigger decode_timeout int, the timeout periods =2 power (reg_decode_timeout_thres) -1

DECODE_TIMEOUT_TASK_SEL.description: 0: software use reset to abort decode process ,1: decoder abort decode process by itself

SOFT_RST.description: when set to 1, soft reset JPEG module except jpeg_reg module

TAILER_EN.description: set this bit to add EOI of "0xffd9" at the end of bitstream

PAUSE_EN.description: set this bit to pause jpeg encoding

MEM_FORCE_PD.description: 0: no operation,1:force jpeg memory to power down

MEM_FORCE_PU.description: 0: no operation,1:force jpeg memory to power up

T0_DQT_INFO.description: Configure dqt table0's quantization coefficient precision in bit[7:4], configure dqt table0's table id in bit[3:0]

T1_DQT_INFO.description: Configure dqt table1's quantization coefficient precision in bit[7:4], configure dqt table1's table id in bit[3:0]

T2_DQT_INFO.description: Configure dqt table2's quantization coefficient precision in bit[7:4], configure dqt table2's table id in bit[3:0]

T3_DQT_INFO.description: Configure dqt table3's quantization coefficient precision in bit[7:4], configure dqt table3's table id in bit[3:0]

VA.description: configure picture's height. when encode, the max configurable bits is 14, when decode, the max configurable bits is 16

HA.description: configure picture's width. when encode, the max configurable bits is 14, when decode, the max configurable bits is 16

T0_QNR_VAL.description: write this reg to configure 64 quantization coefficient in t0 table

CHROMINANCE_QNR_VAL.description: write this reg to configure 64 quantization coefficient in t1 table

T2_QNR_VAL.description: write this reg to configure 64 quantization coefficient in t2 table

T3_QNR_VAL.description: write this reg to configure 64 quantization coefficient in t3 table

RESTART_INTERVAL.description: configure restart interval in DRI marker when decode

COMPONENT_NUM.description: configure number of components in frame when decode

SOS_CHECK_BYTE_NUM.description: Configure the byte number to check next sos marker in the multi-scan picture after one scan is decoded down. The real check number is reg_sos_check_byte_num+1

RST_CHECK_BYTE_NUM.description: Configure the byte number to check next rst marker after one rst interval is decoded down. The real check number is reg_rst_check_byte_num+1

CID_ERR_INT_RAW.description: The raw interrupt bit to sign that scan id check with component fails when decoding.

DECODE_TIMEOUT_INT_RAW.description: The raw interrupt bit to sign that decode pause time is longer than the setting decode timeout time when decoding.

CLK_EN.description: Set this bit to enable clk gate

CAM_VSYNC_FILTER_THRES.description: Filter threshold value for CAM_VSYNC signal.

CAM_UPDATE.description: 1: Update Camera registers, will be cleared by hardware. 0 : Not care.

CAM_BYTE_ORDER.description: 1: Change data bit order, change CAM_DATA_in[7:0] to CAM_DATA_in[0:7] in one byte mode, and bits[15:0] to bits[0:15] in two byte mode.  0: Not change.

CAM_BIT_ORDER.description: 1: invert data byte order, only valid in 2 byte mode. 0: Not change.

CAM_VS_EOF_EN.description: 1: CAM_VSYNC to generate in_suc_eof. 0: in_suc_eof is controlled by reg_cam_rec_data_cyclelen.

CAM_CLK_SEL.description: Select Camera module source clock. 0: no clock. 1: APLL. 2: CLK160. 3: no clock.

CAM_REC_DATA_BYTELEN.description: Camera receive data byte length minus 1 to set DMA in_suc_eof_int.

CAM_LINE_INT_NUM.description: The line number minus 1 to generate cam_hs_int.

CAM_CLK_INV.description: 1: Invert  the input signal CAM_PCLK. 0: Not invert.

CAM_2BYTE_EN.description: 1: The bit number of input data is 9~16.  0: The bit number of input data is 0~8.

CAM_DE_INV.description: CAM_DE invert enable signal, valid in high level.

CAM_HSYNC_INV.description: CAM_HSYNC invert enable signal, valid in high level.

CAM_VSYNC_INV.description: CAM_VSYNC invert enable signal, valid in high level.

CAM_VH_DE_MODE_EN.description: 1: Input control signals are CAM_DE CAM_HSYNC and CAM_VSYNC. 0: Input control signals are CAM_DE and CAM_VSYNC.

CAM_CONV_YUV2YUV_MODE.description: 0: to yuv422. 1: to yuv420. 2: to yuv411. 3: disabled.  To enable yuv2yuv mode, trans_mode must be set to 1.

CAM_CONV_YUV_MODE.description: 0: yuv422. 1: yuv420. 2: yuv411. When in yuv2yuv mode, yuv_mode decides the yuv mode of Data_in

CAM_CONV_DATA_OUT_MODE.description: LIMIT or FULL mode of Data out. 0: limit. 1: full

CAM_CONV_DATA_IN_MODE.description: LIMIT or FULL mode of Data in. 0: limit. 1: full

CAM_CONV_TRANS_MODE.description: 0: YUV to RGB. 1: RGB to YUV.

LCD_CONV_TXTORX.description: 0: txtorx mode off. 1: txtorx mode on.

LCD_CONV_TRANS_MODE.description: 0: YUV to RGB. 1: RGB to YUV.

LCD_DOUT_CYCLELEN.description: The output data cycles minus 1 of LCD module.

LCD_ALWAYS_OUT_EN.description: LCD always output when LCD is in LCD_DOUT state, unless reg_lcd_start is cleared or reg_lcd_reset is set.

LCD_DOUT_BIT_ORDER.description: 1: change bit order in every byte. 0: Not change.

LCD_UPDATE.description: 1: Update LCD registers, will be cleared by hardware. 0 : Not care.

LCD_BIT_ORDER.description: 1: Change data bit order, change LCD_DATA_out[7:0] to LCD_DATA_out[0:7] in one byte mode, and bits[15:0] to bits[0:15] in two byte mode.  0: Not change.

LCD_BYTE_ORDER.description: 1: invert data byte order, only valid in 2 byte mode. 0: Not change.

LCD_DOUT.description: 1: Be able to send data out in LCD sequence when LCD starts. 0: Disable.

LCD_DUMMY.description: 1: Enable DUMMY phase in LCD sequence when LCD starts. 0: Disable.

LCD_CMD.description: 1: Be able to send command in LCD sequence when LCD starts. 0: Disable.

LCD_START.description: LCD start sending data enable signal, valid in high level.

LCD_CMD_2_CYCLE_EN.description: The cycle length of command phase. 1: 2 cycles. 0: 1 cycle.

LCD_WIRE_MODE.description: The wire width of LCD output. 0: 8bit. 1: 16bit 2: 24bit

LCD_VFK_CYCLELEN.description: The setup cycle length minus 1 in LCD non-RGB mode.

LCD_VBK_CYCLELEN.description: The vertical back blank region cycle length minus 1 in LCD RGB mode, or the hold time cycle length in LCD non-RGB mode.

LCD_NEXT_FRAME_EN.description: 1: Send the next frame data when the current frame is sent out. 0: LCD stops when the current frame is sent out.

LCD_BK_EN.description: 1: Enable blank region when LCD sends data out. 0: No blank region.

LCD_CD_DATA_SET.description: 1: LCD_CD = !reg_cd_idle_edge when lcd_st[2:0] is in LCD_DOUT state.  0: LCD_CD = reg_cd_idle_edge.

LCD_CD_DUMMY_SET.description: 1: LCD_CD = !reg_cd_idle_edge when lcd_st[2:0] is in LCD_DUMMY state.  0: LCD_CD = reg_cd_idle_edge.

LCD_CD_CMD_SET.description: 1: LCD_CD = !reg_cd_idle_edge when lcd_st[2:0] is in LCD_CMD state.  0: LCD_CD = reg_cd_idle_edge.

Measurement unit: i2c_sclk

FILTER_CFG.description: SCL and SDA filter configuration register

SCL_FILTER_THRES.description:
Configures the threshold pulse width to be filtered on SCL. When a pulse on the SCL input has smaller width than this register value, the I2C controller will ignore that pulse. 
Measurement unit: i2c_sclk

SDA_FILTER_THRES.description:
Configures the threshold pulse width to be filtered on SDA. When a pulse on the SDA input has smaller width than this register value, the I2C controller will ignore that pulse. 
Measurement unit: i2c_sclk

SCL_FILTER_EN.description: Configures to enable the filter function for SCL.

SDA_FILTER_EN.description: Configures to enable the filter function for SDA.

SCLK_DIV_NUM.description: the integral part of the fractional divisor for i2c module

SCLK_DIV_B.description: the denominator of the fractional part of the fractional divisor for i2c module

SCLK_SEL.description: The clock selection for i2c module:0-XTAL,1-CLK_8MHz.

SCLK_ACTIVE.description: The clock switch for i2c module

COMMAND0.description:
Configures command 0. It consists of three parts: 
op_code is the command,
0: RSTART, 
1: WRITE,
2: READ,
3: STOP,
4: END.

Byte_num represents the number of bytes that need to be sent or received.
ack_check_en, ack_exp and ack are used to control the ACK bit. See I2C cmd structure for more information.

COMMAND0_DONE.description:

SCL_ST_TO_I2C.description:
Configures the threshold value of SCL_FSM state unchanged period. It should be no more than 23.
Measurement unit: i2c_sclk

SCL_MAIN_ST_TIME_OUT.description: SCL main status time out register

SCL_MAIN_ST_TO_I2C.description:
Configures the threshold value of SCL_MAIN_FSM state unchanged period.nIt should be no more than 23.
Measurement unit: i2c_sclk

SCL_RST_SLV_EN.description: When I2C master is IDLE, set this bit to send out SCL pulses. The number of pulses equals to reg_scl_rst_slv_num[4:0].

SCL_RST_SLV_NUM.description: Configures to send out SCL pulses when I2C master is IDLE. The number of pulses equals to reg_scl_rst_slv_num[4:0].

SCL_PD_EN.description:
Configure the pulses of SCL generated in I2C master mode. 
Valid when reg_scl_rst_slv_en is 1.
Measurement unit: i2c_sclk

SDA_PD_EN.description:
Configures to power down the I2C output SCL line. 
0: Not power down.

1: Power down.
Valid only when reg_scl_force_out is 1.

RX_SLAVE_MOD.description: Set this bit to enable slave receiver mode

RX_FIFOMEM_RESET.description: Set this bit to reset Rx Syncfifomem

RX_MONO.description: Set this bit to enable receiver  in mono mode

RX_BIG_ENDIAN.description: I2S Rx byte endian, 1: low addr value to high addr. 0: low addr with low addr value.

RX_UPDATE.description: Set 1 to update I2S RX registers from APB clock domain to I2S RX clock domain. This bit will be cleared by hardware after update register done.

RX_MONO_FST_VLD.description: 1: The first channel data value is valid in I2S RX mono mode.   0: The second channel data value is valid in I2S RX mono mode.

RX_PCM_CONF.description: I2S RX compress/decompress configuration bit. & 0 (atol): A-Law decompress, 1 (ltoa) : A-Law compress, 2 (utol) : u-Law decompress, 3 (ltou) : u-Law compress. &

RX_PCM_BYPASS.description: Set this bit to bypass Compress/Decompress module for received data.

RX_STOP_MODE.description: 0  : I2S Rx only stop when reg_rx_start is cleared.   1: Stop when reg_rx_start is 0 or in_suc_eof is 1.   2:  Stop I2S RX when reg_rx_start is 0 or RX FIFO is full.

RX_LEFT_ALIGN.description: 1: I2S RX left alignment mode. 0: I2S RX right alignment mode.

RX_24_FILL_EN.description: 1: store 24 channel bits to 32 bits. 0:store 24 channel bits to 24 bits.

RX_WS_IDLE_POL.description: 0: WS should be 0 when receiving left channel data, and WS is 1in right channel.  1: WS should be 1 when receiving left channel data, and WS is 0in right channel.

RX_BIT_ORDER.description: I2S Rx bit endian. 1:small endian, the LSB is received first. 0:big endian, the MSB is received first.

RX_TDM_EN.description: 1: Enable I2S TDM Rx mode . 0: Disable.

RX_PDM_EN.description: 1: Enable I2S PDM Rx mode . 0: Disable.

RX_TDM_WS_WIDTH.description: The width of rx_ws_out in TDM mode is (I2S_RX_TDM_WS_WIDTH[6:0] +1) * T_bck

RX_BCK_DIV_NUM.description: Bit clock configuration bits in receiver mode.

RX_BITS_MOD.description: Set the bits to configure the valid data bit length of I2S receiver channel. 7: all the valid channel data is in 8-bit-mode. 15: all the valid channel data is in 16-bit-mode. 23: all the valid channel data is in 24-bit-mode. 31:all the valid channel data is in 32-bit-mode.

RX_TDM_CHAN_BITS.description: The Rx bit number for each channel minus 1in TDM mode.

RX_MSB_SHIFT.description: Set this bit to enable receiver in Phillips standard mode

RX_TDM_CTRL.description: I2S TX TDM mode control register

RX_TDM_PDM_CHAN0_EN.description: 1: Enable the valid data input of I2S RX TDM or PDM channel 0. 0:  Disable, just input 0 in this channel.

RX_TDM_PDM_CHAN1_EN.description: 1: Enable the valid data input of I2S RX TDM or PDM channel 1. 0:  Disable, just input 0 in this channel.

RX_TDM_TOT_CHAN_NUM.description: The total channel number of I2S TX TDM mode.

RX_SD_IN_DM.description: The delay mode of I2S Rx SD input signal. 0: bypass. 1: delay by pos edge.  2: delay by neg edge. 3: not used.

RX_WS_OUT_DM.description: The delay mode of I2S Rx WS output signal. 0: bypass. 1: delay by pos edge.  2: delay by neg edge. 3: not used.

RX_BCK_OUT_DM.description: The delay mode of I2S Rx BCK output signal. 0: bypass. 1: delay by pos edge.  2: delay by neg edge. 3: not used.

RX_WS_IN_DM.description: The delay mode of I2S Rx WS input signal. 0: bypass. 1: delay by pos edge.  2: delay by neg edge. 3: not used.

RX_BCK_IN_DM.description: The delay mode of I2S Rx BCK input signal. 0: bypass. 1: delay by pos edge.  2: delay by neg edge. 3: not used.

LC_FIFO_TIMEOUT.description: the i2s_tx_hung_int interrupt or the i2s_rx_hung_int interrupt will be triggered when fifo hung counter is equal to this value

LC_FIFO_TIMEOUT_SHIFT.description: The bits are used to scale tick counter threshold. The tick counter is reset when counter value >= 88000/2^i2s_lc_fifo_timeout_shift

LC_FIFO_TIMEOUT_ENA.description: The enable bit for FIFO timeout

RXEOF_NUM.description: I2S RX data number control register.

RX_EOF_NUM.description: The receive data bit length is (I2S_RX_BITS_MOD[4:0] + 1) * (REG_RX_EOF_NUM[11:0] + 1) . It will trigger in_suc_eof interrupt in the configured DMA RX channel.

SINGLE_DATA.description: The configured constant channel data to be sent out.

RX_PDM_SINC_DSR_16_EN.description: Configure the down sampling rate of PDM RX filter group1 module. 1: The  down sampling rate is 128. 0: down sampling rate is 64.

RX_PDM_HP_BYPASS.description: I2S PDM RX bypass hp filter or not.

RX_IIR_HP_MULT12_5.description: The fourth parameter of PDM RX IIR_HP filter stage 2 is (504 + LP_I2S_RX_IIR_HP_MULT12_5[2:0])

RX_IIR_HP_MULT12_0.description: The fourth parameter of PDM RX IIR_HP filter stage 1 is (504 + LP_I2S_RX_IIR_HP_MULT12_0[2:0])

PARAM_SKIP_BAND_ENERGY.description: Set 1 to skip band energy check.

PARAM_NOISE_STD_FS_THSH.description: Feature_sum threshold to determine noise_std max value when vad_tag=0, equal to ((noise_std_max)>>11)^2*5

PARAM_THRES_UPD_BDL.description: Noise_std boundary low when updating threshold.

PARAM_THRES_UPD_BDH.description: Noise_std boundary high when updating threshold.

RXFIFO_FULL_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver receives more data than what rxfifo_full_thrhd specifies.

TXFIFO_EMPTY_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when the amount of data in Tx-FIFO is less than what txfifo_empty_thrhd specifies .

PARITY_ERR_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver detects a parity error in the data.

FRM_ERR_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver detects a data frame error .

RXFIFO_OVF_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver receives more data than the FIFO can store.

DSR_CHG_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver detects the edge change of DSRn signal.

CTS_CHG_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver detects the edge change of CTSn signal.

BRK_DET_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver detects a 0 after the stop bit.

RXFIFO_TOUT_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver takes more time than rx_tout_thrhd to receive a byte.

SW_XON_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver recevies Xon char when uart_sw_flow_con_en is set to 1.

SW_XOFF_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver receives Xoff char when uart_sw_flow_con_en is set to 1.

GLITCH_DET_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver detects a glitch in the middle of a start bit.

TX_BRK_DONE_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when transmitter completes  sending  NULL characters after all data in Tx-FIFO are sent.

TX_BRK_IDLE_DONE_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when transmitter has kept the shortest duration after sending the  last data.

TX_DONE_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when transmitter has send out all data in FIFO.

AT_CMD_CHAR_DET_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when receiver detects the configured at_cmd char.

WAKEUP_INT_RAW.description: This interrupt raw bit turns to high level when input rxd edge changes more times than what reg_active_threshold specifies in light sleeping mode.

SW_RTS.description: This register is used to configure the software rts signal which is used in software flow control.

TXFIFO_RST.description: Set this bit to reset the uart transmit-FIFO.

RXFIFO_FULL_THRHD.description: It will produce rxfifo_full_int interrupt when receiver receives more data than this register value.

TXFIFO_EMPTY_THRHD.description: It will produce txfifo_empty_int interrupt when the data amount in Tx-FIFO is less than this register value.

CTS_INV.description: Set this bit to inverse the level value of uart cts signal.

DSR_INV.description: Set this bit to inverse the level value of uart dsr signal.

RTS_INV.description: Set this bit to inverse the level value of uart rts signal.

DTR_INV.description: Set this bit to inverse the level value of uart dtr signal.

SW_DTR.description: This register is used to configure the software dtr signal which is used in software flow control.

CLK_EN.description: 1'h1: Force clock on for register. 1'h0: Support clock only when application writes registers.

RX_FLOW_THRHD.description: This register is used to configure the maximum amount of data that can be received  when hardware flow control works.

RX_FLOW_EN.description: This is the flow enable bit for UART receiver.

WK_CHAR4.description: This register restores the specified wake up char4 to wake up

WK_CHAR0.description: This register restores the specified char0 to wake up

ACTIVE_THRESHOLD.description: The uart is activated from light sleeping mode when the input rxd edge changes more times than this register value.

RX_WAKE_UP_THRHD.description: In wake up mode 1 this field is used to set the received data number threshold to wake up chip.

WK_CHAR_NUM.description: This register is used to select number of wake up char.

WK_CHAR_MASK.description: This register is used to mask  wake up char.

WK_MODE_SEL.description: This register is used to select wake up mode. 0: RXD toggling to wake up. 1: received data number larger than

XON_CHAR.description: This register stores the Xon flow control char.

XOFF_CHAR.description: This register stores the Xoff flow control char.

XON_XOFF_STILL_SEND.description: In software flow control mode, UART Tx is disabled once UART Rx receives XOFF. In this status, UART Tx can not transmit XOFF even the received data number is larger than UART_XOFF_THRESHOLD. Set this bit to enable UART Tx can transmit XON/XOFF when UART Tx is disabled.

SW_FLOW_CON_EN.description: Set this bit to enable software flow control. It is used with register sw_xon or sw_xoff.

XONOFF_DEL.description: Set this bit to remove flow control char from the received data.

FORCE_XON.description: Set this bit to enable the transmitter to go on sending data.

FORCE_XOFF.description: Set this bit to stop the  transmitter from sending data.

SEND_XON.description: Set this bit to send Xon char. It is cleared by hardware automatically.

SEND_XOFF.description: Set this bit to send Xoff char. It is cleared by hardware automatically.

XON_THRESHOLD.description: When the data amount in Rx-FIFO is less than this register value with uart_sw_flow_con_en set to 1  it will send a Xon char.

XOFF_THRESHOLD.description: When the data amount in Rx-FIFO is more than this register value with uart_sw_flow_con_en set to 1  it will send a Xoff char.

TX_BRK_NUM.description: This register is used to configure the number of 0 to be sent after the process of sending data is done. It is active when txd_brk is set to 1.

RX_IDLE_THRHD.description: It will produce frame end signal when receiver takes more time to receive one byte data than this register value.

TX_IDLE_NUM.description: This register is used to configure the duration time between transfers.

DL0_EN.description: Set this bit to delay the stop bit by 1 bit.

DL1_EN.description: Set this bit to delay the stop bit by 1 bit.

PRE_IDLE_NUM.description: This register is used to configure the idle duration time before the first at_cmd is received by receiver.

POST_IDLE_NUM.description: This register is used to configure the duration time between the last at_cmd and the next data.

RX_GAP_TOUT.description: This register is used to configure the duration time between the at_cmd chars.

AT_CMD_CHAR.description: This register is used to configure the content of at_cmd char.

CHAR_NUM.description: This register is used to configure the num of continuous at_cmd chars received by receiver.

MEM_FORCE_PD.description: Set this bit to force power down UART memory.

MEM_FORCE_PU.description: Set this bit to force power up UART memory.

RX_TOUT_EN.description: This is the enble bit for uart receiver's timeout function.

RX_TOUT_FLOW_DIS.description: Set this bit to stop accumulating idle_cnt when hardware flow control works.

RX_TOUT_THRHD.description: This register is used to configure the threshold time that receiver takes to receive one byte. The rxfifo_tout_int interrupt will be trigger when the receiver takes more time to receive one byte with rx_tout_en set to 1.

MEM_TX_STATUS.description: Tx-SRAM write and read offset address.

TX_SRAM_WADDR.description: This register stores the offset write address in Tx-SRAM.

TX_SRAM_RADDR.description: This register stores the offset read address in Tx-SRAM.

MEM_RX_STATUS.description: Rx-SRAM write and read offset address.

RX_SRAM_RADDR.description: This register stores the offset read address in RX-SRAM.

RX_SRAM_WADDR.description: This register stores the offset write address in Rx-SRAM.

ST_URX_OUT.description: This is the status register of receiver.

ST_UTX_OUT.description: This is the status register of transmitter.

TX_SCLK_EN.description: Set this bit to enable UART Tx clock.

RX_SCLK_EN.description: Set this bit to enable UART Rx clock.

TX_RST_CORE.description: Write 1 then write 0 to this bit to reset UART Tx.

RX_RST_CORE.description: Write 1 then write 0 to this bit to reset UART Rx.

TX_AFIFO_FULL.description: Full signal of APB TX AFIFO.

TX_AFIFO_EMPTY.description: Empty signal of APB TX AFIFO.

RX_AFIFO_FULL.description: Full signal of APB RX AFIFO.

RX_AFIFO_EMPTY.description: Empty signal of APB RX AFIFO.

RX_EXT_EN_SEL.description: Configures rx external enable signal selection from IO PAD.

RX_SW_EN.description: Set this bit to enable data sampling by software.

RX_EXT_EN_INV.description: Set this bit to invert the external enable signal.

RX_PULSE_SUBMODE_SEL.description:
Configures the rxd pulse sampling submode. 
4'd0: positive pulse start(data bit included) &&  positive pulse end(data bit included)
4'd1: positive pulse start(data bit included) && positive pulse end (data bit excluded)
4'd2: positive pulse start(data bit excluded) && positive pulse end (data bit included)
4'd3: positive pulse start(data bit excluded) && positive pulse end (data bit excluded)
4'd4: positive pulse start(data bit included) && length end
4'd5: positive pulse start(data bit excluded) && length end

RX_SMP_MODE_SEL.description:
Configures the rxd sampling mode. 
2'b00: external level enable mode
2'b01: external pulse enable mode  
2'b10: internal software enable mode

RX_BITLEN.description: Configures expected byte number of received data.

RX_DATA_ORDER_INV.description: Set this bit to invert bit order of one byte sent from RX_FIFO to DMA.

RX_BUS_WID_SEL.description:
Configures the rxd bus width. 
3'd0: bus width is 1.
3'd1: bus width is 2.
3'd2: bus width is 4.
3'd3: bus width is 8.

RX_GATING_EN.description: Set this bit to enable the clock gating of output rx clock.

RX_TIMEOUT_EN.description: Set this bit to enable timeout function to generate error eof.

RX_EOF_GEN_SEL.description: Configures the DMA eof generated mechanism. 1'b0: eof generated by data bit length. 1'b1: eof generated by external enable signal.

RX_START.description: Set this bit to start rx data sampling.

TX_BITLEN.description: Configures expected byte number of sent data.

TX_DATA_ORDER_INV.description: Set this bit to invert bit order of one byte sent from TX_FIFO to IO data.

TX_BUS_WID_SEL.description:

3'd0: bus width is 1.
3'd1: bus width is 2.
3'd2: bus width is 4.
3'd3: bus width is 8.

TX_START.description: Set this bit to start tx data transmit.

TX_EOF_GEN_SEL.description: Configures the tx eof generated mechanism. 1'b0: eof generated by data bit length. 1'b1: eof generated by DMA eof.

TX_IDLE_VALUE.description: Configures bus value of transmitter in IDLE state.

XDST_LEN_TOO_LARGE_ERR_ST.description: The error is that the scaled image height is larger than (2^13 - 1).
